title: Lundbeck to move US digs to Boston as it eyes bigger innovation frontiers
summary: With Lundbeck steering its R&D engine toward increasingly specialized neuroscience targets, the Danish drugmaker is plotting a U.S. HQ move to one of the country’s preeminent biopharma hotspots.

title: Pioneer of China NewCo model sued in US over trade secret misuse, double-dealing
summary: A legal feud unfolding in New York is putting a spotlight on the work of a business development veteran who is credited for pioneering one of biopharma’s hottest dealmaking mechanism: the China “NewCo” model.

title: Chutes & Ladders—Travere chief makes way for former Amicus CEO
summary: Travere Therapeutics CEO Eric Dube, Ph.D., is stepping down after overseeing the launch of the rare kidney disease drug Filspari.

title: Indivior ends PAM drug collab with Addex ahead of Supernus merger
summary: Ahead of its upcoming merger with Supernus, Indivior Pharmaceuticals has ended its long-running collaboration with Addex Therapeutics to develop positive allosteric modulators (PAMs).

title: Novo inks $1.3B Nanexa deal to unlock long-acting obesity injectables
summary: Novo has struck a 1.17 billion euro ($1.3 billion) deal to combine Nanexa’s long-acting injectable drug delivery platform with its obesity and Type 2 diabetes drugs.

title: Roche's Genentech inks $1.5B bispecific pact with fast-rising Earendil
summary: Roche’s Genentech is paying Earendil Labs $55 million upfront to discover and develop multiple bispecific antibodies. The deal, which focuses on oncology, includes milestones that could take the deal's value above $1.5 billion.

title: ADARx scores upsized $446M IPO, while fellow RNA biotech City maps out Nasdaq plans
summary: ADARx Pharmaceuticals has overshot its own IPO ambitions, as fellow RNA-focused biotech City Therapeutics also plans a public listing.

title: Trump's FDA pick Heidi Overton calls vaccines, mifepristone safe and effective in confirmation hearing
summary: The Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (HELP) today questioned Heidi Overton, M.D., Ph.D., Trump’s pick for FDA commissioner, in a hearing marked by tightrope-walking on issues like vaccines, abortions, flavored vapes and whether or not President Donald Trump is capable of being wrong.

title: ‘It’s actually very radical’: NIH debuts tool to help scientists navigate biomedical database
summary: The NIH’s National Library of Medicine has released the pilot version of a new tool designed to help scientists plumbing the library’s digital trove of scientific papers find related research faster.

title: China’s Henlius carves out $440M T-cell engager deal with Amberstone
summary: Fosun Pharma subsidiary Henlius Biotech has signed a $440 million biobucks deal with California-based Amberstone Biosciences to work on T-cell engagers.

title: Acadia misses mark in Alzheimer’s but concludes phase 3 ‘absolutely worth’ pursuing
summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals’ phase 2 Alzheimer’s disease trial has missed its primary endpoint, but the company and analysts alike saw enough encouraging signals to support the continuation of a phase 3 program.

title: Grail survives adcomm vote as it awaits FDA decision for cancer blood test
summary: Despite a major trial setback earlier this year and increasing questions over its efficacy, medtech Grail has beaten the odds and seen a positive recommendation for its multi-cancer blood test Galleri from FDA advisors.

title: Roche pens backloaded $2B deal with Atavistik to discover allosteric CVRM drugs
summary: Roche has penned a backloaded $2 billion deal with hematology biotech Atavistik Bio to develop allosteric small molecules for cardiometabolic diseases.

title: Merck sees pivotal victory for $3B eye disease prospect
summary: Merck & Co.’s Brunello trial has hit its primary endpoint, shedding light on the effects of a trispecific diabetic macular edema (DME) drug candidate that the Big Pharma bought in a $3 billion takeover.

title: Adagio Medical kicks off strategic review, trims more than half its staff
summary: Adagio Medical has initiated a strategic review of its business and will lay off more than half its full-time workers as the maker of cryoablation devices faces delisting on the Nasdaq exchange.

title: Kyverna ‘resetting conversation’ with 1-year miv-cel data as autoimmune CAR-T peers hit safety snags

title: Lilly puts up $100M, plus billions on the backend, to form 5-target deal with China's InnoCare

title: Enveda reaps $311M series E to feed ambition to become a ‘household name’
summary: Enveda has raised a $311 million series E round, positioning the nature-derived drug discovery company to pursue its goal of becoming a household name over the next decade.

title: Trump's Department of War bets $47M on Flagship biotechs to develop countermeasures
summary: The Department of War has awarded Flagship Pioneering $47 million to develop medical countermeasure technologies against emerging threats.

title: Immunovant ends cutaneous lupus program after phase 2 flop

title: Boehringer adds $250M to value of Variant pact by expanding into cardiovascular disease
